title: HTML over WebSockets: real-time SPAs with barely any JavaScript
summary: This article explores a modern web architecture pattern called 'HTML over WebSockets', where server-rendered HTML is pushed directly to the client via WebSockets, enabling real-time single-page applications without the complexity of traditional JavaScript-heavy SPA frameworks.
problem_solved: Reduces the complexity and JavaScript bundle size of building real-time single-page applications while maintaining instant updates and interactivity.
why_valuable: It offers a simpler, more performant alternative to complex SPA frameworks by leveraging existing web standards and pushing minimal JavaScript to the client.
